justification: Contains only a fragment ('一、问题 只有中文内容，没有论文题目。') with no substantive technical content to evaluate.

title: report_c
justification: Only a single sentence fragment ('感悟 C：关于 positional encoding。') — no real paper text to review.

title: Test Reflection Qwen
justification: One trivial sentence ('This paper discusses attention mechanism. The key insight is self-attention.') with no methods, results, or analysis.

title: Rapidity-even directed flow splitting of protons and antiprotons as a probe of baryon stopping in relativistic heavy-ion
justification: Solid incremental study that introduces the mid-rapidity curvature of rapidity-even p–pbar v1 splitting as a profile discriminator, but is phenomenological and builds closely on the authors' prior work with acknowledged simplifying assumptions.

title: Exploring Academic Influence of Algorithms by Co-occurrence Network Based on Full-text of Academic Papers
justification: Solid incremental application of standard complex-network centrality to algorithm co-occurrence, well executed with model comparison and IRR checks, but builds directly on prior single-entity extraction art.

title: An integrable approach to macroscopic fluctuation theory for the multispecies SSEP
justification: Elegant extension of integrable MFT to the multispecies SSEP via a manifestly symmetric redundant representation, though its impact is confined to a narrow integrable-probability community and it is a theory-only contribution.

title: Automatic Part-of-Speech Tagging of Arabic-English Dictionary Senses through WordNet
justification: A straightforward set-intersection POS-tagging heuristic over WordNet with internally inconsistent evaluation metrics and no released resources, offering little methodological advance.

title: The Line Emission Terahertz Observatory (LETO): Exploring the lifecycle of the ISM and the origins of water
justification: A detailed, well-motivated FIR observatory concept reusing proven Herschel hardware and a strong science case, but presenting no new science method or demonstrated observational results.

title: Analyzing and Encoding the Al-Mawrid Arabic-English Dictionary with the ISO Language Markup Framework and TEI Lex-0
justification: A thorough dual-standard LMF/TEI Lex-0 encoding workflow for Al-Mawrid with honest limitation analysis, though novelty is modest and quantitative evaluation covers only a single letter.

title: Emergence of Gamma-Type Upward-Phase Statistics in the Collatz Map: An Effective Poisson Process Mechanism
justification: Provides a clean mechanistic (Poisson-process) explanation for the empirically observed Gamma statistics of Collatz upward phases with extensive large-scale numerical validation, though it remains an approximation rather than a proof and addresses a niche problem.

title: Hierarchical Muon: Tiled Newton-Schulz Updates for Efficient Muon Optimization
justification: Introduces a well-defined tiled Newton-Schulz formulation for Muon with thorough theoretical, diagnostic, and end-to-end GPU evaluation, though end-to-end wall-clock gains are modest (3-8%) and the training runs are single-seed.

title: Reducing Redundancy in Whole-Slide Image Patching for Scalable Indexing and Retrieval
justification: Proposes a simple cross-class redundancy-pruning heuristic for WSI indexing that yields modest, variable storage savings but degrades minority-class F1, with abstract claims overstating robustness relative to the reported imbalanced-dataset degradation.

title: Enhancing LLMs for Graph Tasks via Graph-aware LoRA Generation
justification: Presents a novel weight-level injection paradigm (GaRA) for graph-LLM adaptation with solid theory, a norm-amplification analysis, and consistent zero-shot gains, though it remains dependent on input-level prompting and is evaluated only on standard benchmarks.

title: Generative Models on Analog Hardware with Dynamics
justification: Introduces a novel Analog Interaction System framework with principled expressivity-enhancing mechanisms and compelling energy estimates, though generative fidelity is moderate and the hardware efficiency claims rest on extrapolated power models rather than fabricated silicon.

title: Field theories for Laplacian Growth
justification: Genuinely novel construction of a lattice field theory directly on the Laplacian-growth process with rigorous perturbative (3-loop) and small-graph checks, though DLA/b-LRW results are deferred and reproducibility is limited by the absence of code/data.

title: Scaling Nonlinear Optimization: Many Problems One GPU
justification: Solid engineering contribution (first GPU-batched NLP solver via iteration fusion and iteration-level batching) with sound multi-benchmark evaluation and open code, but the core idea is an incremental systems advance over IPOPT/MadNLP rather than a new paradigm, and speedups shrink with problem size.

title: Just how sure are you? Improving Verbalized Uncertainty Calibration in Medical VQA
justification: Useful incremental extension of verbalized-calibration training (e.g. ConfTuner) to multimodal medical VQA via a factorial-perturbation design and composite loss, backed by thorough ablations, though it remains a refinement of existing methods and still fails on hard multi-step reasoning.

title: MADoRA: A Fine-tuning Method for Multi-Aspect Data
justification: Well-executed and highly influential PEFT method that adds a principled magnitude/direction decomposition analysis to LoRA, with broad rigorous experiments and open code, though the conceptual advance over LoRA is incremental rather than breakthrough.

title: UniRank: Unified Rank Allocation for Low-Rank LLM Compression
justification: Reasonable incremental advance in low-rank rank allocation (local energy + global cosine-similarity metric plus rank-preserving fine-tuning) with decent experiments, but the key geometric intuition lacks rigorous derivation and the method is one of many similar compression heuristics.
